scripts.dev: concurrently --names host,player,admin --prefix-colors cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev --prefix frontend/host" "npm run dev --prefix frontend/player" "npm run dev --prefix frontend/admin"

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix frontend/host && npm install --prefix frontend/player && npm install --prefix frontend/admin
